name: bookleaf-author-support
description: Author Support & Communication Portal for BookLeaf Publishing

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.start:production: npm run db:setup -w server && npm run start -w server
